subject: Gray out one of the input controls based on the user selection in another input control

messages.author: f912724b32d84d06
messages.subject: Gray out one of the input controls based on the user selection in another input control
parts:
Hallo!

in my 'ui.r" I have 2 inputs:

 selectInput("choice", "Do you want this analysis?", choices = c("No","Yes")),
 numericInput("lowbound", "Specify the lowest bound for this analysis:", value=0,min=0),

When the user WANTS this analysis (input$choice is "Yes"), then the next control ('lowbound') makes sense.
But when the user does NOT want this analysis (input$choice is "No"), then the next control is useless and confusing.
Is there any way to make the second control ('lowbound') gray out or disappear if the user selects "No" in 'choice'?

Thanks a lot!
Dimitri
